changeSet.author: openk9
changeSet.comment: Add the /urls base path to the web crawler plugin drivers of the crawling from URLs registered at the connector root
changeSet.sql: UPDATE plugin_driver SET json_config = JSON_TRANSFORM( json_config, SET '$.baseUri' = RTRIM(JSON_VALUE(json_config, '$.baseUri'), '/') || '/urls' RETURNING CLOB ) WHERE JSON_VALUE(json_config, '$.path') = '/startUrlsCrawling' AND RTRIM(JSON_VALUE(json_config, '$.baseUri'), '/') NOT LIKE '%/urls' AND RTRIM(JSON_VALUE(json_config, '$.baseUri'), '/') NOT LIKE '%/sitemap';
